description: This is a test class for the ChartService component in the OrangeHRM Dashboard module. It sets up the testing environment, including mocking dependencies and fixtures, and contains unit tests for methods like getChartDao() and getEmployeeDistributionBySubunit() of the ChartService.

classes.name: ChartServiceTest
classes.description: A unit test class extending KernelTestCase to test ChartService functionalities within OrangeHRM Dashboard plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ChartService instance, loads fixtures, and sets up mock dependencies before each test.

methods.name: testGetChartDao
methods.description: Tests that the getChartDao() method of ChartService returns an instance of ChartDao.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeDistributionBySubunit
methods.description: Tests the getEmployeeDistributionBySubunit() method returns expected distribution data and subunit count pairs.
